plain: A local peace officer, such as a low-ranking police officer in Britain

webster.text: The Lord High Constable of England, the seventh officer of the crown.

example.quote: In the first place, the writ is universal, being directed "to all and singular justices, sheriffs, constables, and all other officers and subjects"; so that, in short, it is directed to every subject in the King's dominions.
example.cite: James Otis, Argument Against Writs of Assistance, 1761
